propositions: Four graph functions (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) have cyclomatic complexity in the range 16-22, exceeding a threshold of 15.
The reduce_all + drop error/fsck + index loop is duplicated identically in _find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph, driving unnecessary complexity.
BFS skeleton logic for graph traversal is hand-rolled in _get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level separately, duplicating logic for queue/visited bookkeeping.

A shared load_indexed_states helper should extract the identical reduce/filter/index pattern; a shared accumulator-returning bfs skeleton should replace the two hand-rolled traversals, preserving behavior.
All four refactored functions must maintain their current node-set and traversal results, verified against existing test suite without modification to tests.
Target complexity ceilings are ≤8, ≤8, ≤8, and ≤12 respectively; baseline must shrink-only after regeneration.
